headline: Fox & Mandal advised Asian Games medalist Jyothi Yarraji on brand promotion association with Cosmix
sum: Jyothi Yarraji, India's national record holder in the women's 100m hurdles and an Asian Games medalist, has entered into a brand promotion contract with Cosmix. Fox & Mandal advised Jyothi Yarraji, through her talent management company,…
detail: Jyothi Yarraji, India's national record holder in the women's 100m hurdles and an Asian Games medalist, has entered into a brand promotion contract with Cosmix. Fox & Mandal advised Jyothi Yarraji, through her talent management company, Purnam Talent Management, on this transaction. The Firm reviewed the brand promotion contract. The transaction team consisted of Saurav Bhaumik (Partner), Rudresh Mandal (Principal Associate) and Afshaa Hakim (Associate).
